title: The localized ringed cube commutes after taking exchange mates
statement: For any ringed restriction cube C:OpenCube r j, the canonical derived exchange mates satisfy the restriction equation of step 7 of lem-sf-ringed-restriction-exchange-open-descent. This is valid for any scheme map j, with no openness assumption. The upper and base comparison factors are the inverses of the specified ambient derived inverse-image square comparisons.

proof.text: Apply the ordinary inverse-image cube equation on modules at every object.
Exact localization preserves the cube. Normalize all six localized square isomorphisms to the published ambient comparisons.

Use the four specified derived adjunctions and the four inverse side comparisons in exchangeMate_cube. The defining equations of the four exchange transformations give the stated equation. TypedDerivedCube packages the actual data; its abstract mate proof is specialized only after normalization, avoiding expansion of the concrete comparisons.

lean.statement:
theorem restriction_exchange_cube (r : StrictTowerRingedSquare sq)
    (C : OpenCube r j)
    (K : DerivedCategory (proEtaleRingModules X r.RX)) :
    (basePull C.targetFace).mapDerivedCategory.map ((exchange r).app K) ≫
        (exchange C.targetFace).app ((upperPull r).mapDerivedCategory.obj K) ≫
        (targetPush C.localRings).rightDerivedFunctor.map
          ((proEtaleAmbientRingedPullbackComparison C.upperSquare
            C.upperFace.RX C.upperFace.RY C.upperFace.RX' C.upperFace.RY'
            C.upperFace.cf C.upperFace.cg C.upperFace.cg' C.upperFace.cf'
            C.upperFace.coherent).inv.app K) =
      (proEtaleAmbientRingedPullbackComparison C.baseSquare
            C.baseFace.RX C.baseFace.RY C.baseFace.RX' C.baseFace.RY'
            C.baseFace.cf C.baseFace.cg C.baseFace.cg' C.baseFace.cf'
            C.baseFace.coherent).inv.app ((verticalPush r).rightDerivedFunctor.obj K) ≫
        (basePull C.localRings).mapDerivedCategory.map ((exchange C.sourceFace).app K) ≫
        (exchange C.localRings).app ((upperPull C.sourceFace).mapDerivedCategory.obj K)
